defs.def: to give sb sth that they can use, or some work or responsibility 分配（某物）；分派，布置（工作、任务等）

ex.s: When I finally started to study, I would race through the assigned work, often well past midnight.
ex.t: 等我终于开始学习时，我会匆匆忙忙赶完布置的作业，常常早已过了午夜。

ex.s: These qualities, in turn, are mapped onto products that have been assigned a gender.
ex.t: 最有效的生活方式是努力成为那种罕见的混合体——狐狸式刺猍。

ex.s: For instance, if an object’s name was meant to sound genderless, like Miuu, participants would still assign a gender to it — they would assume Miuu was a “he” or “she.”
ex.t: 例如，如果一个物体的名字本意是无性别的，比如Miuu，参与者仍会给它赋予性别——他们会假定Miuu是“他”或“她”。

ex.s: For example, one participant’s experience of “We sat and listened to the waves at the beach for a while” was assigned the categories “sitting at beach” and “listening to waves.”
ex.t: 例如，一位参与者"我们坐在海滩上听了一会儿海浪"的体验被归入"坐在海滩"和"听海浪"两类。

ex.s: The rules that assign meaning lie not just inside our heads, but also outside, in society, in social memory, social conventions and social relations.
ex.t: 赋予意义的规则不仅存在于我们头脑内部，也存在于外部——在社会中，在社会记忆、社会惯例和社会关系中。

ex.s: Above all, I hoped he wouldn't assign me to work with the fiercely competitive, extremely serious fellow who always wore dark clothes and apparently had a personality to match.
ex.t: 最重要的是，我希望他不会把我分配给那个竞争心极强、极其严肃、总是穿深色衣服、而且显然性格也与之相称的家伙。

ex.s: Additionally, from time to time I will assign group work to be completed in class or short assignments to be completed at home, both of which will be graded.
ex.t: 此外，我会不时布置课堂内完成的小组作业或课后完成的短作业，两者都会评分。

defs.def: to provide a person for a particular task or position 指定；指派

ex.s: Most of my reading through primary， middle and high school was factual reading． I read for knowledge， and to make A's on my tests． Occasionally， I would read a novel that was assigned， but I didn't enjoy this type of reading． I liked facts， things that are concrete． I thought anything abstract left too much room for argument．
ex.t: 在小学、初中和高中阶段，我的大部分阅读都是事实性阅读。我为获取知识而读，为了在考试中拿A。偶尔，我也会读老师指定的小说，但我并不喜欢这种阅读。我喜欢事实，喜欢具体的东西。我认为任何抽象的事物都留下了太多争论的空间。

ex.s: SoFi Stadium requires you to park strictly in your assigned zone, and guests must enter through the exact gate indicated on their color-coded digital parking pass.
ex.t: SoFi体育场要求你严格在指定区域停车，并且宾客必须通过其彩色编码电子停车证上标明的确切入口进入。

ex.s: All the assignments will be submitted by the assigned date through Blackboard, our online learning and course management system.
ex.t: 所有作业必须在指定日期前通过Blackboard提交，这是我们的在线学习和课程管理系统。

ex.s: Class activities will vary from day to day, but students must be ready to complete short in-class writings or tests drawn directly from assigned readings or notes from the previous class' lecture/discussion, so it is important to take careful notes during class.
ex.t: 课堂活动每天不同，但学生必须准备好完成直接取自指定阅读或上节课讲座/讨论笔记的简短课堂写作或测试，所以课堂上认真记笔记很重要。

defs.def: to send a person to work under the authority of sb or in a particular group 委派；派遣

ex.s: Each group will be assigned several missions.
ex.t: 当听到我这样说时，我一直在琢磨英语在那个时刻是否一文不值/在那个时候。

ex.s: For each one, assign a member of the group to be a first-aid instructor, a victim, and a rescuer.
The class were assigned group projects on the topic "How Information TechnologyAffects OurLives".LiZhen'sgroup ispresentingtheir research on the development of information technology.
ex.t: 班级被分配了以“信息技术如何影响我们的生活”为主题的小组项目。李珍的小组正在展示他们关于信息技术发展的研究。

ex.s: The Silk Road began to develop in the 2nd century BCE: Assigned by the emperor the ambassador Zhang Qian journeyed from Chang'an to Central Asia, seeking to build bridges between the Han Dynasty and the Western Regions.
ex.t: 丝绸之路始于公元前2世纪：受皇帝委派，使节张骞从长安出发前往中亚，寻求在汉朝与西域之间搭建桥梁。

defs.def: to say that sth has a particular value or function, or happens at a particular time or place 确定（价值、功能、时间、地点）

ex.s: Just a specially printed piece of paper and hemp that we've assigned value to — and probably less durable over time than those shells.
ex.t: 只是一张特别印制的纸和我们赋予价值的麻纤维——而且随着时间的推移可能还不如那些贝壳耐用。

defs.def: to say that your property or rights now belong to sb else 转让，让与（财产、权利）

ex.s: In the 1970s, Lu was assigned to compile an English-Chinese dictionary.
ex.t: 20世纪70年代，陆被委派编纂一部英汉词典。
